findings.title: Escape/back did not close intro
findings.repro: Enter intro without overlay; invoke Escape/existing back. Initial Back only closed tool and re-rendered.
findings.sourceFollowup: Back handles OpeningActive and finishes it; settings-back clears overlay and returns to paused intro. Final Render provides a Back toolbar before start and during intro settings.
testsRequired: held input does not activate underlying game
coverage: SkipFirstFrameAndEscapeConsumeInput: first-frame skip and actual keyboard Escape from replay
findings.gap: Integrated held-cut/timeout and synthetic focus/pause-clock regressions pass. Physical focus-held-input remains unmeasured.

findings.title: Missing image bypassed required readable fallback
findings.repro: Approved/diagnostic profile present but openingImage null. Initial entry called StartGame; opening UI required non-null texture.
findings.sourceFollowup: ShowOpening is independent of texture; null image leaves the solid panel and same action/copy path.
testsRequired: null image displays caption and skip/settings
skip from fallback preserves game/save state
coverage: MissingImageKeepsReadableInkFallbackAndSkip: null texture, solid panel, skip, labels, initial state/head/no save
findings.gap: Integrated150% caption fit passes; diagnostic150% and final ordinary intro screenshots are visible. Other aspect ratios/corrupt profile are not separately certified.

findings.title: Tool replay drops arrow/D-pad navigation
findings.repro: While a T0 reader/circuit tool remains open, enter settings and replay intro. Render preserves ToolPanel=true while overlay=null. WatchInput routes keyboard arrows/D-pad to Adjust, whose OpeningActive guard returns.
findings.expected: Opening/replay supplies an interface-navigation input context while retaining underlying tool for return.
findings.sourceFollowup: Render sets Watch.ToolPanel=tool!=null&&!OpeningActive. Opening therefore owns arrow/D-pad navigation while the underlying tool remains preserved for replay return.
coverage: ReplayFromToolKeepsKeyboardNavigationAndReturnContext: ToolPanel false, keyboard Down selects settings, replay returns settings then reader, journal head unchanged
findings.gap: Physical D-pad remains unmeasured; shared routing branch is verified in source.

findings.title: Cached intro eligibility does not follow save-slot changes
findings.repro: Initialize with fresh primary store, choose existing recovery slot from title settings, then Start: cached openingEligible can still force intro. Conversely an explicitly new recovery slot can retain previous ineligible/finished flags.
findings.expected: Recompute/cancel/reset opening policy at selected/new/retried slot transitions using the actual restored/new state.
findings.sourceFollowup: ConfigureOpening cancels prior opening/replay and clears finished state; selected existing and retry paths pass false, explicitly new recovery slot resets journal/tool/document/start and passes true.
coverage: SelectingExistingSlotBypassesAndCreatingNewSlotRestoresFreshIntro: existing bypass, new fresh intro and old slot bytes preserved
findings.gap: Recovery-retry path is source-reviewed but not exercised in the 11 targeted methods.

findings.title: Intro settings offers an enabled no-op saved-slots action
findings.repro: During intro open settings and activate saved-slots. OpenOverlay rejects any id except settings while OpeningActive, silently retaining settings.
findings.expected: Hide/disable unsupported saved-slot action with a reason or implement a deliberate safe restore transition.
findings.sourceFollowup: Settings adds saved-slots only when !OpeningActive, removing the enabled no-op route.
coverage: SelectingExistingSlotBypassesAndCreatingNewSlotRestoresFreshIntro: asserts saved-slots absent during opening settings
